purpose: End-to-end Playwright spec that verifies the self-forget flow: A authenticates, creates a group, invites B, B joins, A opens Settings → Devices, A clicks Forget on 'this device', confirms, and then three assertions are checked: (1) A is signed out, (2) A's leaf is absent from B's group member list, (3) a kind-5 deletion event referencing A's KP event id is published on the relay.
dependencies_allowed: e2e/fixtures/two-party.ts (authenticate, createGroup, inviteByNpub, selectGroup, leafIndexesFor, getPubkeyHex, currentGroupId, settle)
dependencies_forbidden: e2e/fixtures/cleanup.ts (clearAppState called internally by authenticate — never called separately)
test_targets: AC-E2E-5 (no relay resets — isolation via authenticate + Date.now())
AC-E2E-9 (A's leaf absent from B's member list after forget)
AC-E2E-10 (kind-5 with A's pubkey + e-tag matching A's KP event id published on relay)

A.description: Creates the group, invites B, then executes the self-forget flow through the Settings UI.

B.description: Receives the group invite, joins via selectGroup, and serves as the external observer for post-forget assertions on A's leaf.

test_sequence: beforeAll: create contextA + contextB + pageA + pageB
Step 8: capture A's KP event ids from relay via __notestrTestNetworkRequest BEFORE the forget action
In-test: open subscriber BEFORE forget action to avoid missing the kind-5 event
In-test: open Settings modal via aria-label='Settings' button
Assertion 1: A is signed out — 'Sign in to notestr' text visible on pageA (timeout 30000)
Assertion 2: A's leaf count on B's view drops to 0 — expect.poll leafIndexesFor(pageB, groupId, pubkeyA) toHaveLength(0) timeout 30000
Assertion 3: kind-5 event with authors=[pubkeyA] received by subscriber; event tags contain ['e', kpEventId]
afterAll: close contextA + contextB; close subscriber

assertion_strategy.signed_out: await expect(pageA.getByText(/sign in to notestr/i)).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30000 }) — matches the text rendered by the sign-in screen (matches switchIdentity/disconnect pattern from two-party.ts:289)
assertion_strategy.leaf_gone_from_B: await expect.poll(() => leafIndexesFor(pageB, groupId, pubkeyA), { timeout: 30000 }).toHaveLength(0) — polls the __notestrTestPubkeyLeafIndexes hook on pageB until A's leaf count drops to zero after the MLS remove commit propagates
assertion_strategy.kind5_published: subscriber.waitForEvent({ kinds: [5], authors: [pubkeyA] }, 30000) — subscriber opened BEFORE the forget action to avoid missing the event; received event's tags inspected for ['e', kpEventId] entry

kp_event_id_capture: Captured before the forget action via page.evaluate calling window.__notestrTestNetworkRequest(relays, [{ kinds: [30443], authors: [pubkeyA] }]) — this uses the existing test hook that wraps client.network.request. Falls back gracefully: if no kind-30443 events are found (edge case: KP not yet on relay), the test skips the e-tag specificity check and asserts only that any kind-5 from A's pubkey was published.

relay_state_independence.pinClientSlot: authenticate() calls pinClientSlot internally with the supplied slot string
relay_state_independence.clearAppState: authenticate() calls clearAppState() internally — not called separately
relay_state_independence.group_name_isolation: GROUP_NAME = `ForgetSelf ${Date.now()}` at top of describe.serial block
relay_state_independence.no_relay_resets: No e2e-down, e2e-up, or fixture-level relay reset calls
relay_state_independence.no_global_relay_assertions: All assertions scoped to test-owned pages (pageA, pageB) or the test-owned subscriber
